senses: to sin, miss, miss the way, go wrong, incur guilt, forfeit, purify from uncleanness
to sin, miss the goal or path of right and duty
to incur guilt, incur penalty by sin, forfeit
to induce to sin, cause to sin
to bring into guilt or condemnation or punishment
to miss oneself, lose oneself, wander from the way

strongs.def: properly, to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference, to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn
strongs.kjv: bear the blame, cleanse, commit (sin), by fault, harm he hath done, loss, miss, (make) offend(-er), offer for sin, purge, purify (self), make reconciliation, (cause, make) sin(-ful, -ness), trespass
